annotations.title: Mundo free 3D catalogue: search and check

description: Searches the catalogue of Mundo (Neblla's 3D engine): free CC0 low-poly 3D pieces only. search {query} in Spanish or English returns ids; load one in client.js with world.load("catalog:<id>"), never with a guessed id. get, list, doll (the standard figure), check_obby (validates an obby level JSON). Paid content by other authors: neblla_store_search. More: neblla_get_llms tools/assets

action.description: What to do. By action: search {query, kind?, limit?, lang?}; get {id}; list {kind?, offset?, limit?}; check_obby {obby}

id.description: get: the piece's id, as search returned it (e.g. tree-pine).

kind.description: search / list: only this kind of piece.

lang.description: search: "es" or "en", the language of the title.

limit.description: search / list: most pieces to return (search: 10 by default, 50 at most).

obby.description: check_obby: the obby JSON, as an object or its text.

offset.description: list: how many pieces to skip.

query.description: search: what the piece is, in any words, e.g. "plataforma" or "spike trap".
